testcase.name: strict SemVer precedence handles prereleases and ignores build metadata
legacy expected-version flag is rejected with local selection guidance
only complete passes promote, equal versions refresh, and downgrades are scope-local
concurrent scope publications merge and stale runs cannot lower a scope
lock contention times out with evidence and leaves the success record untouched
invalid CLI versions block and retain execution provenance without a success record
a hung version command is killed and recorded as blocked
acceptance artifacts are excluded even when not gitignored
source mutations during a run block promotion and retain execution evidence
source evidence distinguishes tracked and untracked changes at the same HEAD
